description: This file defines the class 'Smarty_Internal_TestInstall', which performs diagnostic tests on a Smarty installation, verifying directories, plugins, cache, and system plugins for proper setup and accessibility.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_TestInstall
classes.description: A utility class for testing and diagnosing the setup of a Smarty template engine installation.

methods.name: testInstall
methods.description: Performs a comprehensive check of Smarty installation directories, plugin files, system plugins, cache, config, and plugin accessibility, returning true if all checks pass.
